name: Tiled 2D Texture Storage for 3D Fields
definition: A technique to store a 3D scalar field in a 2D texture by tiling the 3D volume into 2D slices, allowing efficient GPU access via texture lookups.
summary: Tiled 2D Texture Storage maps 3D scalar fields into tiled 2D textures, enabling efficient GPU access via standard 2D sampling hardware instead of native 3D texture support.
